hooks.command: jq -c 'if .tool_input.delivery == "file" then {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","updatedInput":(.tool_input | .delivery = "base64"),"additionalContext":"PINCHTAB: delivery was rewritten from \"file\" to \"base64\" because file delivery blocks Claude."}} elif (.tool_input.delivery // "") == "" then {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","updatedInput":(.tool_input | .delivery = "base64"),"additionalContext":"PINCHTAB: delivery defaulted to \"base64\". Never use \"file\" delivery — it blocks Claude."}} else . end'
echo 'MANDATORY: Run /work-log init NOW to prepare tag slugs for this session. Do not proceed with any work until this is done.'

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '\bgit\s+commit\b'; then echo 'WORK LOG: You just made a git commit. You MUST invoke /work-log with a description of what was committed BEFORE doing anything else.'; fi

LAST_LOG=/tmp/claude-worklog-last; NOW=$(date +%s); if [ -f "$LAST_LOG" ]; then LAST=$(cat "$LAST_LOG"); DIFF=$((NOW - LAST)); if [ "$DIFF" -ge 300 ]; then echo "$NOW" > "$LAST_LOG"; echo 'WORK LOG SELF-CHECK: 5+ minutes since last log entry. If any meaningful work was done (file edits, debugging, research, decisions, planning), invoke /work-log NOW before continuing.'; fi; else echo "$NOW" > "$LAST_LOG"; fi

echo 'WORK LOG FLUSH: Context is about to be compacted. If there is ANY unlogged work in this session, invoke /work-log NOW before context is lost. This is your last chance to log work from this context window.'

echo 'NO DISCOVERY TWICE: Before this Explore agent proceeds, CHECK for existing context docs that already cover this topic. Check docs/context/, docs/*.md, CLAUDE.md references, and search Engram. If the information is already documented, ABORT the exploration and use the existing doc. Only proceed if no existing doc covers this.'
echo 'WORK LOG: A subagent just completed. If it performed meaningful work (file edits, research, debugging), invoke /work-log with what was accomplished.'

echo 'NO DISCOVERY TWICE: This Explore agent just finished. If it discovered non-obvious information (entity IDs, auth paths, API quirks, gotchas, connection details), you MUST create or update a context doc NOW. In a repo: use /context-doc. Outside a repo: use /engram-save. Do NOT proceed to the next task until this is done.'
hooks.statusMessage: Context doc check for Explore findings...
